div.head: Ordal 3
div.ab: 7 þonne þæt ordal géara sy, þonne gan twegen menn inn of ægðre healfe, 7 beon híg ánrǽde, þæt hit swa hát sy, swa wé ær cwædon.
Et quando iudicium paratum erit, ingrediantur ex utraque parte duo homines, et sint certi ut ita calidum sit, sicut prediximus.
And þonne þæt ordal géara sy, þonne gan twegen menn inn of ægðre healfe, and beon híg anrǽde, þæt hit swa hát sy, swa wé ær cwædon.
And when the ordeal is ready two men shall go in from either party, and they shall be agreed that it is as hot as we have declared.

Und wenn das Ordal[wasser] bereit ist, dann sollen von beiden Seiten [des Klägers und des Verklagten] je 2 Männer hineingehen; und seien sie einstimmig, dass es so heiss ist, wie wir eben gesagt haben.
And when the ordeal [water] is ready, then let two men go in from each side [of plaintiff and accused]; and let them agree that it is as hot as we have just said.
